title: Penelope T
content: I vividly remember that when I was two to twelve years old, I could induce OBEs. I would just sit or lie down and concentrate really hard. Then my consciousness would leave my body and float above it. First in my room, then I would leave my house, my city, my country, and fly high up into the upper atmosphere and out into the universe. I could see Earth from far away and "fly" through the universe. The feeling was complete freedom from gravity and the weight of my body. I was liberated and exceptionally happy. I was the universe, and the universe was me. I never saw any entities, deceased relatives, or religious figures. I just felt an immense feeling of extreme happiness. I knew what was happening to me. I could go back to my body whenever I wanted and repeat this experience anytime. I have an extremely good memory, almost photographic. I could remember everything since I was six months old. Around age twelve, I wasn’t able to do it anymore, no matter how hard I tried. I just lost it. I’m still trying to leave my body again.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No, I was perfectly fine, Other (briefly specify), No illness at all
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, I could see colors more clearly
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe, I was the universe, and the universe was me
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, We are the universe. We create our universe, and the universe creates us
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience
